title: Binance Will Update the Collateral Ratio of Multiple Assets Under Portfolio Margin (2025-04-25)
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance will update the  collateral ratio  for the following assets under Portfolio Margin from  2025-04-25 06:00 (UTC).  The update will be completed within approximately  one hour . Assets Collateral Ratio (Before) Collateral Ratio (After) ZEC 70% 60% TWT 70% 60% ZIL 70% 55% ONE 70% 55% ROSE 70% 55% C98 70% 55% ANKR 70% 50% SKL 70% 50% COTI 70% 50% 1INCH 65% 45% Please Note:  Collateral ratio  will affect  the Unified Maintenance Margin Ratio (uniMMR). Users should monitor uniMMR closely to avoid any potential liquidation or losses that may result from the change of collateral ratio.  There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise.
